sentences.japanese: 我が家の裏には家庭菜園があります。
sentences.english: There is a kitchen garden behind my house.

sentences.japanese: 以前は私の家の裏に、大きな桜の木がありました。
sentences.english: There used to be a big cherry tree at the back of my house.

sentences.japanese: 不幸の裏には幸いあり。
sentences.english: Every cloud has a silver lining.

sentences.japanese: 表なら俺の勝ち。裏ならお前の負けだ。
sentences.english: Heads I win, tails you lose.

sentences.japanese: その問題の裏には複雑な状況がある。
sentences.english: There are complicated circumstances behind the matter.
